[P] Placement choices and revision review
|
|-- Retained candidate revision: available for display, review, or both
|-- Presentation alternatives (document.alternatives)
|   |-- promote: pin source/base revisions and whole or subtree scopes
|   |-- select: swap all parts per placement; resolve overlapping choices
|   |-- nested choices require a selected parent
|   |-- project rows with provenance; bound revision stays unchanged
|   `-- side panel: compare a pinned part in regular or diff mode
|
|-- Revision reviews (document.revisionReviews)
|   |-- record base/head revisions and accept/reject decisions
|   |-- save decisions without changing bound content
|   `-- apply: check dependencies and conflicts; preserve unrelated edits
|       `-- bind reviewed result when changed
|
`-- An alternative may link to a review; promotion is explicit.
    History records choices and reviews; revision payloads stay immutable.
